data.name: HibernateUnavailable
data.value: Hibernation is turned off on this PC.

data.name: SleepUnavailable
data.value: Sleep is not available on this PC.

data.name: TipShutdown
data.value: Turns the PC off. Open programs are closed without asking.

data.name: TipRestart
data.value: Restarts the PC. Open programs are closed without asking.

data.name: TipHibernate
data.value: Saves the session to disk and turns the PC off. The next start brings everything back as you left it.

data.name: TipSleep
data.value: Puts the PC into a low-power state. It wakes in seconds with everything still open.

data.name: TipAt
data.value: Runs at a set date and time.

data.name: AppTimedHibernate
data.value: Windows has no timer for hibernation, so Shutdown runs the countdown itself:

data.name: AppTimedSleep
data.value: Windows has no timer for sleep, so Shutdown runs the countdown itself:

data.name: MsgMissed
data.value: The scheduled time passed while the PC was asleep or hibernating. Nothing was run.

data.name: ErrPast
data.value: This time is in the past.

data.name: ErrTooSoon
data.value: Choose a time at least 1 minute from now.

data.name: ErrSleepFailed
data.value: The PC could not go to sleep. Windows refused it.

data.name: ErrAccessDenied
data.value: This account may not run this action. Ask an administrator for permission.

data.name: ErrCommandLine
data.value: The command line contains invalid arguments.

data.name: ErrUnexpected
data.value: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.

data.name: CloseGuard
data.value: The countdown runs in this window. Closing it cancels the countdown.

data.name: NewerBuildWaits
data.value: A newer version was started. This window stays open so the scheduled action can run.

data.name: NewerBuildWaitsUnsaved
data.value: A newer version of Shutdown was started. The schedule in this window could not be saved, so the new version would not show it. Start the new version again once this schedule is cancelled.

data.name: MsgOldCancelled
data.value: The previous schedule was cancelled and no new one was set.

data.name: ErrInvalidTime
data.value: This time does not exist on that day because the clocks go forward.

data.name: MsgNotSaved
data.value: The schedule is set but could not be saved, so Shutdown will not show it after you close it.

data.name: ElevatedRunning
data.value: Shutdown is already running as administrator. Switch to its window, or close it and start Shutdown again.

data.name: InstallerWelcomeDescription
data.value: Shutdown lets you choose when your PC shuts down, restarts, hibernates or goes to sleep.%n%nThis wizard installs version %1 in a few steps. Click Next to get started.

data.name: InstallerDowngrade
data.value: Shutdown %1 is already installed. Setup cannot replace it with %2.

data.name: InstallerPreviousUninstallFailed
data.value: The existing installation could not be removed. Close Shutdown and uninstall it from Windows Settings before continuing.

data.name: InstallerPerUserFirst
data.value: Shutdown is already installed for your account only. Uninstall that copy from Windows Settings first, then run Setup again.

data.name: InstallerPortableDescription
data.value: Copies only Shutdown.exe to the selected folder.

data.name: InstallerDeleteAppData
data.value: Also delete the Shutdown settings and logs?

data.name: InstallerDeleteAppDataFailed
data.value: Some settings or logs could not be deleted.

data.name: InstallerCompilerMissing
data.value: Inno Setup 6 compiler (ISCC.exe) was not found.

data.name: InstallerCompileFailed
data.value: Could not compile the Shutdown installer.

data.name: InstallerCloseFailed
data.value: Shutdown is still running. Close it and try again.

data.name: InstallerCloseAnyway
data.value: Shutdown is still open, for example because hibernation or sleep is scheduled. Close it anyway? The schedule is then cancelled.

data.name: InstallerStartFailed
data.value: Could not start the installed copy of Shutdown.
